description: CER - Small-scale Installations - Small Generation Unit - Wind (POA) May 2001-Dec 2001 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Clean Energy Regulator. This dataset presents the footprint of the number of installations of small generation unit (SGU) wind systems and their rated output in kilowatts (kW). The data spans the months from May to December for 2001 and includes the total over the months. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Clean Energy Regulator. Its tags are energy. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
